page_title: SEV 1-1 OSA | Sevilla v Osasuna 28/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' 18:13 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
90+6' Sevilla have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

90+5' Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper, however, denies him with a stunning save. Sevilla force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+5' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Guillermo Cuadra blows for a foul.
90+4' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Osasuna.
90+2' Johan Mojica (Osasuna) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
90' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
89' The Osasuna players are exchanging some short passes.
86' He’s off! Suso (Sevilla) gets his marching orders from referee Guillermo Cuadra after the VAR review.

84' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Suso (Sevilla), but referee Guillermo Cuadra must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
84' Suso (Sevilla) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
84' Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
84' Orjan Nyland displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Ante Budimir (Osasuna) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) will replace Raul Garcia.
82' Surely that's handball by one of the Sevilla players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!

79' The most active player in today's match is definitely Isaac Romero (Sevilla). He's trying to be on the ball as much as possible and you can literally see the enthusiasm in his play. He keeps exchanging some one touch passes and waits for the right moment to send a killer pass. What a player!
77' Suso (Sevilla) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
76' Substitution. Moi Gomez makes his way off the pitch and Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) comes on as his replacement.
76' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to substitute Pablo Ibanez and he is replaced by Jon Moncayola (Osasuna).
74' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.

72' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom right corner, but Sergio Herrera shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
71' Here comes a substitution. Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) is brought on as a substitute for Jesus Navas.
71' Quique Sanchez Flores has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Rafa Mir (Sevilla) replacing Marcao.
70' Oliver Torres (Sevilla) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
67' Djibril Sow is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Oliver Torres (Sevilla).
65' Substitution. Ruben Pena is replaced by Jesus Areso (Osasuna).
64' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
63' Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
62' The game is interrupted now, Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
61' Osasuna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
59' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) comes onto the pitch so that Marcos Acuna can be given a rest.
59' Here is a change. Lucien Agoume is going off and Quique Sanchez Flores gives the last tactical orders to Djibril Sow (Sevilla).
56' Boubakary Soumare (Sevilla) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
55' 1 - 1 Ante Budimir (Osasuna) collects the ball deep inside the box from a rebound following the corner kick. He beats the keeper with a sharp low shot in the middle! Quite a nice goal!
55' Osasuna force a corner. They send men into the box.
54' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
54' The ball is cleared after Ruben Pena (Osasuna) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play and Osasuna manage to earn a corner.
53' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
51' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) sends a cross into the box, but Sergio Herrera comes off his line to gather the ball.
49' The game is interrupted. Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
46' The second half has just started.
45+1' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Marcao (Sevilla) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
43' Marcao (Sevilla) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
41' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
37' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
33' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) unleashes a rocket of a shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
30' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Sergio Herrera.
29' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle as Isaac Romero (Sevilla) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
28' The corner is swung in but Osasuna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
25' 1 - 0 Isaac Romero (Sevilla) receives a well-taken defence-splitting low pass inside the box and scores! His great effort makes its way into the bottom right corner of the net.
22' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
20' One of the Sevilla players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
17' 3:0 – the total goal attempt statistics.
15' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.

13' A short through ball almost allows Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) to get in a good shooting position, but he loses it to one of the defenders. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
10' Osasuna are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence.
8' Sergio Herrera displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
6' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
5' Sevilla quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

5' Excellent touch by Isaac Romero (Sevilla)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and produces a low drive towards the right post. The goalkeeper pulls off a beautiful save to deny him. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Sevilla.
3' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Ruben Pena (Osasuna), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Osasuna will kick the game off.
Guillermo Cuadra got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
